association_runtime_accounting.note: Stage 3 per-configuration runtimes cover rule scoring/ranking only; the shared co-occurrence construction is a one-time cost per training interaction definition.

stage3_category_cbf.conclusion: The six-list collapse is a tie-handling consequence, not evidence that category metadata alone is sufficient. Ascending program ID selects the numerically lowest five candidates within the tied category/categories.

item_vectors.note: With only category features, every candidate in a category has an identical sparse vector up to IDF weighting; therefore all candidates in that category receive exactly the same score.

stage3_interpretation_corrections.popularity_training_counts: Popularity used qualifying_airings_primary: distinct training users with at least one >=80% qualifying airing; ties by qualifying airing count, then program ID.
stage3_interpretation_corrections.repeat_cbf_association_training_counts: Stage 3 repeat, CBF profiles, and association-rule interactions read positive_airings: any positive observed coverage, not the >=80% threshold.
stage3_interpretation_corrections.validation_labels: Unchanged Stage 3 frozen primary labels: fully observed airings at >=80% coverage; top 5 by qualifying-airing count.
